title: Certificates of Deposit: Maturity Instructions That Pay Out to a Closed Account
content:
Piedmont Crescent Bank pays the balance of a maturing certificate among its Certificates of Deposit only into an account that is still open. This page concerns a maturity instruction that sends the balance to a PCB checking or savings account which has since been closed: such an instruction cannot be carried out when grace ends, and the bank replaces it.

## The bank's obligation

The replacement is the bank's own obligation. It is owed on the strength of the certificate record and the status of the named account, whether or not the owner contacts the bank. The owner sees the new maturity instruction, and the payout account now on record, as soon as the change is made.

## Recording the replacement: `update_maturity_instruction_96ab509d`

This is an agent-side tool. Before it can be used it has to be unlocked with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`; after that the agent runs it via `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Capability.** The tool overwrites two settings of one certificate: the maturity instruction, which decides what the certificate does when its grace period ends, and the PCB account recorded as the certificate's payout account. The certificate's interest disposition is not touched. The new settings show on the certificate record immediately.

**Inputs, one by one.**

- `certificate_id` identifies the certificate whose instruction is replaced; it is the certificate reference number obtained from the certificate lookup for this customer.
- `renewal_instruction` is the maturity instruction to record, and takes exactly one of four values:
  - `auto_renew`: when grace ends, the certificate renews into its renewal tier;
  - `pay_out_to_checking`: when grace ends, the whole balance goes to the payout checking account;
  - `pay_out_to_savings`: when grace ends, the whole balance goes to the payout savings account;
  - `mail_check`: when grace ends, the whole balance is paid by an official check mailed to the address on file.
- `payout_account_id` is the account reference number, taken from the checking or savings account lookup, of the customer's own PCB checking or savings account to be recorded as the payout account.

**Receipt.** On success the tool answers with `certificate_id`, `renewal_instruction` (the instruction now on record), `payout_account_id` (the payout account now on record) and `recorded_at` (the moment of the change as the system clock shows it). A receipt that echoes the new instruction means the change has been recorded.

## Basis Q&A

**Is the owner's permission a condition of the replacement?** The replacement is owed by the bank; it does not depend on the owner calling in.

**Does the tool itself decide which instruction is proper?** No. It records the instruction and account it is given.
